fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 2020 Bennington pontoon boat with trailer.
findings: Pontoon logs and fencing look clean and glossy in the garage and outdoor shots
Mooring cover is on in the garage photo, so the deck and seating are mostly not shown
Seat vinyl visible behind the life vests looks clean
Three of five photos show accessories (life vests, tube) rather than the boat itself
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2020 Bennington SLLX20, and it looks like it has been well kept in that heated garage. If it would help, we can come to you and do a pre-sale wash, wax and interior wipe-down so the logs and seats look their best in photos and for showings. Would you like a quote?
